run_command: python solution/main.py doctor --input input && python solution/main.py run --input input --output output && python solution/main.py resume --checkpoint output/checkpoint.chk --artifacts output --steps 50 --output output/continued
notes: Fix for the reported coordinate-convention mismatch (state.xml vs trajectory last frame, 5.4246 nm). Root cause: sample getState used enforcePeriodicBox=False while final getState used enforcePeriodicBox=True, so state.xml contained wrapped coordinates while trajectory frames contained unwrapped ones. Change: ALL sampling and final state extraction now use enforcePeriodicBox=False consistently in cmd_run, make_recorder, and cmd_resume. The recorder, the final state.xml written by both run and resume, and the resume continuity check therefore all operate on unwrapped coordinates. Periodic box vectors are still preserved (checkpoint carries them; serialized state.xml still contains box vectors). Binary checkpoint still written with sim.saveCheckpoint. Velocities/time retained. CUDA mixed/DeviceIndex=0/DeterministicForces=true, 200 physical PME steps + 50 resumed steps unchanged. Validation strengthened, not weakened: cmd_run now aborts with RuntimeError if state.xml positions differ from trajectory[-1] by more than STATE_FRAME_TOL_NM = 1e-9 (positions), and if time differs by more than 1e-6 ps. Same in cmd_resume. Resume continuity check tightened from 1e-4 to 1e-9 nm for positions. run.json now records the coordinate convention and the state-vs-last-frame deltas in both position and velocity.
